SELECT pap.supplier_id, ps.name AS supplier_name, SUM(pap.number) AS purchase_total_count, COALESCE(a.is_inbound_delivery, 1) AS is_inbound_delivery FROM pur_yt_apply_purchase pap LEFT JOIN pur_yt_supplier ps ON pap.supplier_id = ps.id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub sos ON pap.order_sub_id = sos.id left join sal_yt_order a on sos.order_id=a.id and a.is_inbound_delivery is not null LEFT JOIN pro_yt_product_specification pps ON pap.product_specification_id = pps.id LEFT JOIN pro_yt_product pp ON pap.product_id = pp.id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_customer sc ON pap.customer_id = sc.id WHERE pap.is_deleted = 0 and pap.number>0
AND a.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderCode}, '%')
AND sos.sub_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderSubCode}, '%')
AND pp.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productCode}, '%')
AND pps.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{specificationName}, '%')
AND ps.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{supplierName}, '%')
AND sc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%')
AND pap.sales_employee_id = #{salesEmployeeId}
GROUP BY pap.supplier_id, ps.name,COALESCE(a.is_inbound_delivery, 1) ORDER BY max( pap.create_time) DESC
SELECT pap.* FROM pur_yt_apply_purchase as pap WHERE order_sub_item_id = #{orderSubItemId} AND pap.is_deleted = 0
